name: Firefly Blue Ghost Mission 1
full_name: Firefly Aerospace Blue Ghost Mission 1 (CLPS) — Mare Crisium
note: First AFTER: flown cited night against the current public product sentence. Product Surface Operations: Lunar day + night; Power > 400 W. Flown: 5 h after sunset, designed_for_night false, did not wake after a full night. store_Wh / energy_wh OPEN — do not invent watt-hours. Product page does not print 354 h. Peak vs night keep-alive OPEN. Do not mix BGM2.
electrical_model: CLAIM_VS_WITNESS. No Fourier leak. No P×H watt-hours. Store OPEN so 354 h watt-hours cannot be computed. Identity is hours_after_sunset_flown vs 354 h Cataldo/Mason as a duration gap, not a DIE on invented Wh.
witness_note: flown — firefly_blue_ghost_m1 landed 2025-03-02 Mare Crisium. after_sunset_h 5.0 cited. designed_for_night false. woke_after_night false. energy_wh null. (NASA/Firefly cited, not our measurement).
killer_claim_vs_witness: store_Wh OPEN; energy_wh OPEN; cannot compute 354 h watt-hours. Product 'Lunar day + night' is not a 354 h promise (page does not print 354 h). Flown 5 h after sunset; designed_for_night false; did not wake after a full night. >400 W is a product/bus figure — peak vs night keep-alive OPEN.
thermal_hold_md: No printed BGM1 night hold T_box or sink K on the product page or the wrap-up. LPSC 1958: not designed to survive the cold lunar night. Do not invent T_env.
alloy_md: No printed night-path alloy for watt-hours. Fourier not run. Store OPEN.
honesty_md: We did not measure; NASA/Firefly/LPSC 1958 cited. Product page does not print 354 h — do not call 'Lunar day + night' a 354 h watt-hours promise. >400 W / 400 watts is not labeled peak vs night keep-alive. energy_wh not printed. Do not mix Blue Ghost Mission 2.

product_surface_ops.cite: Firefly Blue Ghost product page, Payload Resources, Surface Operations: Lunar day + night. Page does not print 354 h.

payload_power_W.cite: Firefly Blue Ghost product page, Payload Resources, Power: > 400 W (greater-than printed). LPSC 2026 1958: With 400 watts of power (vehicle resource with comms; not labeled night keep-alive). Peak vs night keep-alive OPEN. Do not multiply by 354 h.

after_sunset_h.quote: operating just over 5 hours into the lunar night with the final data received around 6:15 pm CDT on March 16
after_sunset_h.cite: Firefly wrap-up 2025-03-17: operating just over 5 hours into the lunar night; Following the sunset, Blue Ghost operated for 5 hours into the lunar night. LPSC 2026 1958: As intended, Blue Ghost operated five hours after the end of the lunar day. NASA release prints multiple hours, not 5.0.
after_sunset_h.page_or_figure: Firefly wrap-up lead; LPSC 1958 End Of Mission

designed_for_night.quote: The mission was concluded as Blue Ghost was not designed to survive the cold lunar night.
designed_for_night.cite: LPSC 2026 1958 End Of Mission. Witness designed_for_night false.

woke_after_night.quote: Eventually, the batteries depleted, and the lander avionics and radios shut down.
woke_after_night.cite: LPSC 2026 1958: batteries depleted; avionics and radios shut down; not designed to survive the cold lunar night. No wake after a full night printed. Witness woke_after_night false.

cataldo_mason_night_h.quote: A complete lunar day cycle is 354 hours of sunlight and 354 hours of darkness.
cataldo_mason_night_h.cite: Cataldo & Mason, Survive and Operate Through the Lunar Night Workshop 2018 (LPI Contrib. 2106): 354 h of darkness. Duration identity only. Firefly product page does not print 354 h. Not watt-hours Wh.

daylight_ops_h.quote: completing more than 14 days of surface operations (346 hours of daylight)
